D.t: Deborah Ross leads by 49.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 160,446 votes; a one point swing is about 1,613 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +41.0 and D +57.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
